sayLines.line: A man, maybe 60s will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
🗣️ A person, maybe 60s, with a farmer's tan to Oliver, by the fire: "Stone. We need 58 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."
